outcome: rate of breastfeeding within the first 24 h
cohort: 1730 pregnant women recruited from 9 hospitals in Shanghai
finding: Compared to routine Obstetrician-led Maternity Care, Midwife-led Care at Delivery (MCD) and Continuity of Midwife-led Care (CMC) were associated with lower CS rates and improved postpartum wellbeing.
mod_finding: Compared with routine Obstetrician-led Maternity Care (OMC), Midwife-led Care at Delivery (MCD) was associated with lower rates of caesarean section (OR were 0.16; 95%CI: 0.11 to 0.25) and a higher total score of postpartum wellbeing (βwere 2.70; 95%CI: 0.70 to 4.70).
